title: How to find documentation of dbruntime.dbutils.FileInfo class
question:
I'm relatively new to Python, Spark and Cloud. I'm currently using the method dbutils.fs.ls(path), the databricks documentation doesn't specify that it returns a FileInfo object. When I do a "type()" of the elements of the result of executing the "ls", the type is dbruntime.dbutils.FileInfo. I cannot backtrack any documentation of this Class, I only know about it's methods using the dir(dbutils.fs.ls(path)[0]) command.

How do I properly move around this kind of problems where there is not a direct documentation? I expected it to be some kind of Python specific class but it is not as it is using dbruntime.

I tried searching the official databricks documentation, stackoverflow questions, Microsoft and AWS documentation.
answer:
To access files on a Databricks File System (DBFS) mount using local file APIs, you will need to prepend "/dbfs" to the file path.

with open('/dbfs/mnt/test_file.json', 'r') as file:
    for line in file:
        print(line)

Documentation at Databricks File System for more details, especially regarding any limitations.
